notes.title: Free Dlc release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 
we just released a free dlc for SixGenerals. After downloading the dlc, click on the second tab on the left in the tavern. Complete each task to receive these generals.

notes.title: English version for SixGenerals
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 
we produced the English version of the SixGenerals.
Click Settings in the login page, you can choose the English language .
If your network is not good, you can choose the stand-alone version in the settings, stand-alone and online version is independent ,their data is also separate.

We have updated the function guide and hope the following documents are helpful to you.
